sources.name: Chapel of Bones

ingest.reason: 403s a plain fetch, and headless Chrome gets a Cloudflare interstitial; a real browser's rendered DOM carries ~30 schema.org MusicEvent blocks.

sources.notes: 658 Maywood Ave. Metal venue + coffee lounge. Its own site (chapelofbones.com/events/) is a dead end — the listings render client-side and its WordPress /feed/ and /events/feed/ both return zero items, which is why this source logged zero hits W26–W34. Bandsintown is the venue's real listing surface: 403s a plain fetch, but a browser-rendered load exposes ~30 schema.org MusicEvent JSON-LD blocks with name/startDate/location/url — extract those rather than scraping text. Bandsintown carries CONCERTS ONLY; the venue also runs karaoke, burlesque, yoga, trivia and art pop-ups that only chapelofbones.com lists, so keep it in Phase B too.

sources.name: Burning Coal Theatre Company
sources.notes: Performs at Murphey School Auditorium, 224 Polk St. Follow the current season page (e.g. /season-30/) from the nav — it is server-rendered with run dates, venue, and showtimes. Do NOT sweep /calendar-of-events/: it is a Modern Events Calendar widget that renders client-side and serves zero event data to a plain fetch. Season runs are listed as date ranges (e.g. 'Oct 8 – 25, 2026') with performances Thu–Sat 7:30pm and Sun 2:00pm; expand a run into one occurrence per performance. Dark between productions — expect zero hits in those gaps.

sources.name: NC State University
sources.notes: Localist. Take the feed WHOLE — the 7-day window is ~65 instances, and the "Arts and Culture" topic (type[]=133874) returns 13 while mis-tagging an Agroecology Education Farm workshop as arts. Carries JC Raulston Arboretum and Witherspoon Student Center programming, which the blocked *.arts.ncsu.edu pages do not serve. Mixes public and academic events — filter to public.

sources.name: UNC Chapel Hill
sources.notes: Localist; events.unc.edu redirects here. Take the feed WHOLE — the 7-day window is only ~29 instances, and narrowing it with Localist's "Arts and Culture" topic (type[]=43092631608229) drops PlayMakers, which the calendar lists with no location. Carries Ackland Art Museum and PlayMakers, neither of which has a usable feed of its own (events.ackland.org 404s /api/2/events). Mixes public and academic events — filter to public.

sources.name: Duke University
sources.notes: Bedework ICS: VEVENTs use DURATION rather than DTEND, and write LOCATION:None where there is none. Mixes public and academic events — filter to public. index.ics only spans ~4 days ahead (39 VEVENTs on 2026-09-07, latest start 09-10) and ignores ?days=, ?end= and ?fq=; index.json is the same 40 events. A low Duke count is that ceiling, not a quiet week — cover the rest in Phase B. arts.duke.edu is NOT a feed: its listings link back here, and its WordPress /wp-json/wp/v2/event returns 3109 posts whose acf is empty and whose only date is the post publish date.

sources.name: Carolina Performing Arts
sources.notes: UNC's presenting organization; programs Memorial Hall plus Moeser Auditorium (Hill Hall), Gerrard Hall, Morehead Planetarium and The Chapel of the Cross. /current-season/ is the working surface: it serves 200 to a plain fetch and server-renders the whole season, one row per performance (title, venue, date, time, event-page link) — this source is NOT fetch_blocked, and the flag it carried through 2026-W36 also suppressed validate's link check. Do NOT sweep /calendar/: it is client-rendered and serves zero dates. tickets.carolinaperformingarts.org is a client-rendered Tessitura app with no server-rendered dates, and no CPA page carries Event JSON-LD, so read the season page's text rather than reaching for a browser. Season-only: the 26/27 season opens 2026-10-13, so the W36 zero was a genuine dark week, not a fetch failure — expect zeros between seasons. calendar.unc.edu lists only a couple of Memorial Hall shows per season (2 in a 60-day window against 28 here), so unc-calendar does not cover this source; dedup against it on the overlap.

sources.name: PlayMakers Repertory Company
sources.notes: UNC's professional resident theater, in the Center for Dramatic Art (Paul Green Theatre, Kenan Theatre). /whats-on/ is server-rendered but lists date RANGES only ("Sep 9 - 27, 2026") with no showtimes — follow through to the production page for performance times. Productions also arrive through the calendar.unc.edu Localist feed titled without the company name ("Oedipus: King/Colonus") and with no location, where feed_scope local supplies Chapel Hill — dedup against unc-calendar.

sources.name: Things To Do In Raleigh (u/Thingstodo919 weekly post)
sources.notes: A curated Fri/Sat/Sun list of 100-200 Triangle events, posted to r/raleigh every Thursday or Friday, each linked to its primary page. Read with `npx tsx scripts/leads_source.ts`; build every event from the linked page, never from the post. Used on a non-commercial basis (Reddit's Public Content Policy: learning and community). Reddit allows one unauthenticated feed fetch per ~45s and Claude Code's WebFetch refuses reddit.com, so fetch once per run via the CLI or curl with a UA.
